# Audrey Ra Design

> A woman-owned creative business offering watercolor instruction, online courses, group workshops, and hand-painted art products for mindfulness and creative expression.

Audrey Ra Design is based in Chicagoland and combines art education with e-commerce, offering both digital learning experiences and physical art products. The business emphasizes watercolor techniques, mindfulness through art, and community engagement through workshops and team-building experiences.

## Key Topics

- Watercolor workshops
- Online courses
- Group workshops
- Mindfulness art
- Team-building

## Courses & Learning

- [Online Courses](https://www.audreyradesign.com/online-courses): Online watercolor courses including Skillshare and The Watercolor Garden
- [Learn](https://www.audreyradesign.com/learn): Learning resources hub with online courses, watercolor tutorials, and workshops
- [Group Workshops](https://www.audreyradesign.com/group-workshops): In-person and virtual group workshops in Chicagoland for team-building and mindfulness

## Products & Shop

- [Audrey Ra Design Shop](https://shop.audreyradesign.com): ARD shop selling hand-painted stationery, greeting cards, and home goods
- [Freebies](https://shop.audreyradesign.com/pages/freebies): Free downloads including digital wallpapers and calligraphy practice templates
- [Audrey's Favorite Supplies](https://www.audreyradesign.com/favorite-supplies): Curated list of Audrey's favorite art supplies with affiliate links and recommendations
